ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup did fire (swing low in, momentum turned up), but it's LATE — price is already extended above the cycle low (formed ~24 day(s) ago @ 1226.09) and overbought (daily RSI 71). A momentum cross is a LAGGING confirmation: after a vertical run it only triggers once the move is mature, so the bottoming entry has already passed. This is a chase, not a fresh buy. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Don't initiate here. Wait for a pullback toward the 10-day average — or the next daily-cycle low to set up — for a lower-risk entry; hold if you're already long.

entry.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended and overbought (daily RSI 71). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.

ladder.early_note: ⚡ Early topping signs (heads-up): StochRSI dropped out of overbought. These anticipate a high BEFORE confirmation — a heads-up to protect gains, not a sell trigger yet.
ladder.why_zh: 日线筑底形态确实已经触发（摆动低点出现、动量转向上行），但为时已晚——价格已显著高于周期低点（约 24 天前形成 @ 1226.09）且已超买（日线 RSI 71）。动量交叉属于滞后确认：在垂直拉升之后，只有当走势已经成熟时才会触发，因此筑底入场早已错过。这是追高，而非新的买入。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 此处不宜建仓。等待回调至 10 日均线附近——或下一个日线周期低点构筑成形——以获得风险更低的入场；若已持有则可继续持有。
